name: adversarial-multimodel-review
description: Always-on deep, full-context adversarial review. Coordinates independent critic subagents, resolving one strong model per distinct provider (OpenAI/Google/Anthropic) at runtime so reviews stay multi-model as Cursor model slugs rotate, then requires the parent agent to verify model diversity before presenting the review as true multi-model. The parent agent writes a structured evidence packet to `.adversarial-review/` (user intent quotes, rejected approaches, accepted plan, diff, tests) that critics MUST read before producing findings, since Cursor subagents cannot see parent chat history.
